data.customLabel: Agent Platform API returns an org owner's gh OAuth token (10-10 21:27)
data.evidence: Key used from 69.48.229.143 on 10-10 21:13-21:28Z. GET /api/v1/managed_agents/agents?limit=100 returned managed-agent config including the GitHub CLI OAuth token of one of BerriAI's two org owners, which the service used to open PRs [BerriAI]. data.customLabel: Legitimate pipeline builds and signs from the lookalike fork
data.evidence: Images built in staging (~11:00-11:06Z) with SLSA provenance naming github.com/Berri-AI/litellm; promoted with no rebuild and signed with the legitimate cosign key.
